一场无与伦比的危机即将席卷我们的星系。唯有新成立联盟的联合力量才能拯救我们。

将组成反对危机的联盟帝国，引发星系范围冲突。我们将对[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]宣战。
label.en:
A crisis of unparalleled proportions is about to engulf our galaxy. Only the combined strength of a newly formed alliance can save us. 

Will form a coalition of empires opposing the crisis, resulting in a galaxy-wide conflict. We will declare war against the [hyperthermia_empire.GetName].

label.zh: 危机时刻，每个物种都应该自救。我们拥有独立解决的能力。
label.en: In times of crisis, it is every species for themselves. We have the strength to resolve this on our own.

label.zh: [hyperthermia_empire.GetName]的方法符合我们新星系的愿景。契合于此，我们或可幸免于看似灾难的全力冲击。
label.en: The methods of [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] conform to our vision of a renewed galaxy. In light of this alignment, we may be spared the full force of what others will deem a catastrophe.

label.zh: 玩火的帝国司空见惯。此动荡终将过去，置身事外就好了。
label.en: An empire playing with fire is hardly a novelty. This upheaval will pass, as all things do. There is little reason to involve ourselves.

label.zh: 开启专项「热耐性进化」
